title: PALEOMAP Paleodigital Elevation Models for the Phanerozoic

grid.transformation: Every finite, exactly integral source z value is stored losslessly as signed 16-bit little-endian metres in unchanged north-to-south, west-to-east row order. No spatial or temporal interpolation is stored.

webPreview.derivation: Retain every third source row and column, including all four geographic edges. Values remain exact selected source integer metres; no smoothing, averaging or spatial or temporal interpolation is stored.

visualization.maximumZoomGroundSampling: approximately 0.088 degrees per display pixel at the equator
visualization.resampling: bilinear display sampling from one selected 0.1 degree metre grid

scientificLimitations: These are modelled PaleoDEM interpretations, not measured ancient elevation or bathymetry, ground truth or uncertainty surfaces.
Each displayed surface is selected from an independent five-million-year nominal archive frame; no temporal interpolation or extrapolation is performed.
Canvas colours and bilinear sampling are visualization choices; every canonical grid retains the original integer metre values and polar rows.
Web Mercator display stops at approximately plus or minus 85.051 degrees although each source grid retains both polar rows.
PALEOMAP terrain is independent of CAO2024 geometry and observations and PBDB paleocoordinates. Overlay does not imply spatial co-registration.
